name_reason: Compliant with global naming: data_fd2_ prefix + battle domain (battle core table) + descriptor summon_spell_sfx_bank_index_table. The descriptor accurately reflects content and role: a per-summon lookup table of FDOTHER.DAT SFX-bank entry indices for the summon-spell cinematic, keyed by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20. The trailing _index_table is semantic (it IS an index table), NOT a Ghidra address residue: no tail equals 0x5255B or any data address. The 4-entry dimension is a domain dimension (4 summon spells 0x20..0x23), carried by the semantics, not address noise. Consistent with the established convention used by the three adjacent sibling palette tables (data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_palette_{r,g,b}_table @ 0x5254F/0x52553/0x52557) already documented in btltab2.c.
purpose: Per-summon FDOTHER.DAT entry index of the SFX bank loaded for the summon-spell (zhao-huan-xi) cinematic. Last of four adjacent per-summon tables (R/G/B palette @ 0x5254F/0x52553/0x52557, then this @ 0x5255B). The loaded bank supplies the sound samples played during the summon strobe/animation/teardown phases.
logic_summary: Holds 4 per-summon bank-index bytes LE-packed into one dword = 0x5E5D5C5B, i.e. {0x5B,0x5C,0x5D,0x5E}, indexed by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20: [0]0x20=0x5B, [1]0x21=0x5C, [2]0x22=0x5D, [3]0x23=0x5E. Sole accessor fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (@ 0x27FC9) loads the WHOLE dword into a stack-local at entry (MOV EAX,[0x5255B] / MOV [ESP+0x14],EAX; single xref is the READ @ 0x27FF5) and then byte-indexes that LOCAL copy by summon_idx: at 0x2813D-0x28141, MOV EAX,[ESP+0x50] (spell_id) / MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [ESP+EAX*1-0xC] (= local_copy[spell_id-0x20], the -0xC = 0x14 stack slot biased by -0x20). The byte is passed to fd2_load_dat_resource(0x51A4D "FDOTHER.DAT", 0, bank) and the returned buffer stored in data_fd2_audio_summon_spell_sfx_bank_buf_ptr @ 0x5411F. Because the byte-index lives in the consumer operating on its local dword copy, the global itself is a scalar uint32 holding the 4 bytes (an array would decay to a pointer at the whole-dword copy and store the address instead of the bytes). Matches the current Ghidra datatype 'dword'/undefined4 (len 4).
datatype: const uint32 (dword, 4 bytes; Ghidra dtype undefined4/dword len=4; 4 FDOTHER.DAT bank-index bytes LE-packed = 0x5E5D5C5B, NOT uint8[4])
element_semantics: The 4 LE-packed bytes are per-summon FDOTHER.DAT sub-file/entry indices for the SFX bank, one per summon spell: byte0=0x5B (0x20 xi-tian-shi), byte1=0x5C (0x21 feng-yao-jing), byte2=0x5D (0x22 po-huai-shen), byte3=0x5E (0x23 an-xie-gui). Each is a resource index (not a VGA channel), so values are not bounded by 0x3F. The whole dword is copied out once and byte-indexed in the consumer by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20.
comment_original_issue: src per-symbol comment block (btltab2.c lines 137-161) was already accurate, precise, ASCII, and complete (purpose; the whole-dword-copy-then-byte-index mechanism with the exact MOV/MOVZX disasm; the scalar-uint32-not-uint8[4] reasoning; const-ness with single READ xref; values; the FDOTHER.DAT-index-vs-VGA-channel distinction; sibling R/G/B relationship). Ghidra side: the detailed comment lived in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field (PLATE_COMMENT was null), and carried stale emit-pipeline metadata -- it labeled the symbol 'byte[4]' and 'emit_action: emit_c_const (4-byte initialised byte array)', conflicting with the verified scalar-uint32 conclusion and the current Ghidra dword datatype.
notes: Single xref = READ @ 0x27FF5 (data load) in fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast; no writers anywhere -> const confirmed (matches src 'const uint32'). Memory at 0x5255B = 5B 5C 5D 5E (LE = 0x5E5D5C5B), byte-identical to the src initializer 0x5e5d5c5b. Disassembly of the consumer confirms the whole-dword load into stack slot [ESP+0x14] then MOVZX byte ptr [ESP+EAX*1-0xC] (= local_copy[spell_id-0x20]) indexing, proving the scalar-uint32 (not uint8[4]) layout; the bank byte feeds fd2_load_dat_resource(0x51A4D=FDOTHER.DAT,0,bank). Did NOT edit btltab2.c (comment already accurate -> comment_verdict keep). Ghidra data plate migrated from the deprecated/partly-stale PRE_COMMENT (byte[4] + emit metadata) to PLATE_COMMENT (per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism) via run_script_inline, refined to match the src conclusion (scalar uint32 / 4 LE-packed FDOTHER.DAT bank-index bytes, const, single READ xref); PRE_COMMENT cleared.
